objective: Read Familia Romana, Fabellae Latinae, Fabulae Syrae and Epitome Historiae Sacrae with the knowledge acquired in the complete game.

gates.condition: All four works have a verified inventory of constructions, contrasts, lexical senses and reading demands; no empty placeholders are counted as coverage.
Every required learning item has explicit question references in the design, or a verified reference to existing Amphitheatrum/Forum coverage.
Each learning group has several distinctly named cards, each testing one precise point in complete original sentences.
Morphological distinctions and vowel quantities are intentionally represented and assessed, including Italia versus Italiā in the first group.
Every group's encountered lexemes are tested at its end in both directions, once per lemma per direction, with no lexical quiz interleaved before its sentence activities.
All section/card titles, instructions, courses and feedback are Latin; French occurs only as source/target translation material.
Only starting cards are free; other cards including vocabulary have positive prices and explicit acyclic prerequisites coherent with Forum.
All authored content has been checked for Latin correctness, unambiguous accepted answers, diagnostic distractors and pedagogical progression.
No subject-specific runtime logic or question generator; original visuals preserved; complete design validation, relevant tests and builds pass.

completionRule: Every gate must pass. A playable subset, card count, build or successful technical suite alone is not completion.
